content_id.description: Content-ID extracted from the MIME payload; is stripped of leading and trailing <> characters

content_transfer_encoding.description: Content-Transfer-Encoding extracted from the MIME payload

content_type.description: Content-Type extracted from the MIME payload

file_extension.description: File extension from context such as headers

file_type.description: File type determined by looking at the magic bytes in the file

md5.description: MD5 hash of the raw contents

raw.description: Base64 encoded source of the file

sha1.description: SHA1 hash of the raw contents

sha256.description: SHA256 hash of the raw contents

size.description: Size of the file in bytes

Mdm_serviceAuthResults.description: Results of authentication. Supported fields include 'Authentication-Results', 'X-Original-Authentication-Results', 'X-MS-Exchange-Authentication-Results', 'X-Agari-Authentication-Results', 'Authentication-Results-Original', and 'ARC-Authentication-Results'. Specification details can be found at https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc8601

dkim.description: Verdict of the Domain Keys Identified Mail check

dkim_details.description: List of details of the Domain Keys Identified Mail checks

dmarc.description: Verdict of the Domain-based Message Authentication, Reporting & Conformance check

instance.description: Instance number of this auth result (if ARC)

spf.description: Verdict of the Sender Policy Framework

type.description: The type of authentication result, derived from the field name

Mdm_serviceAuthSummary.description: Summary of authentication results for the message

links.description: All links found in the banner, unique by the target and display text/url.

text.description: The text content from the warning banner.

ips.description: IP Addresses located in the body

links.description: All links found in the body of the message, unique by the target and display text/url.

previous_threads.description: The previous texts threads of the message'

Mdm_serviceBodyHTML.description: The body part containing content-type text/html

display_text.description: Visible text of the HTML document, with invisible characters removed and non-ASCII characters converted to ASCII spaces.

inner_text.description: Inner text of the HTML document that doesn't include HTML tags.

links.description: All links found in the HTML part of the body of the message

raw.description: Decoded raw content of a body text type (text/[subtype] section)

Mdm_serviceCompAuth.description: Composite Authentication result, used by Microsoft O365

Mdm_serviceDMARC.description: Details of the Domain-based Message Authentication, Reporting & Conformance check

action.description: Indicates the action taken by the spam filter based on the results of the DMARC check. For more information see https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/security/office-365-security/anti-spam-message-headers?view=o365-worldwide#authentication-results-message-header-fields

sub_policy.description: Policy for the subdomain of the organizational domain

verdict.description: Describes the results of the DMARC check for the message

received_hop.description: The lowest hop at which the DMARC check was made

Mdm_serviceDomain.description: Domain parsed from X-Authenticated-Domain or X-Authenticated-Sender headers, which represents the domain used for sender authentication, typically the domain of the sending organization. This field provides additional context for analyzing the legitimacy of the sender

domain.description: The fully qualified domain name (FQDN). This may not *always* be routable, e.g. when an email address contains a domain that is just a TLD with no SLD, e.g. foo@WIN-bar

punycode.description: Interpreted punycode if the domain starts with xn--. For example, if 'domain' is 'xn--ublimesecurity-4xc.com' then 'punycode' is śublimesecurity.com

root_domain.description: The root domain, including the TLD

sld.description: Second-level domain, e.g. 'windows' for the domain 'windows.net'

tld.description: The domain's top-level domain. E.g. the TLD of google.com is 'com'

Mdm_serviceExternal.description: Cloud API provider or other external source metadata

created_at.description: The created time of the message as provided by the cloud API (G Suite or Office 365) or other external source. This is typically the time the external source received the message

message_id.description: The message ID as provided by the cloud API (G Suite or Office 365) or other external source

route_type.description: whether the message was sent or received

spam.description: The upstream mail gateway determined the message to be spam. For cloud API providers, this will be the same as spam_folder. For other implementation methods like transport rules, this will be determined by message header values (e.g. X-SPAM) if supported

spam_folder.description: The message arrived in the user's spam folder. This only applies to cloud APIs (G Suite or Office 365)

thread_id.description: The thread/conversation's unique ID as provided by the cloud API (G Suite or Office 365)

date.description: Date the email was sent in UTC.

date_original_offset.description: UTC timezone offset of the sender

domains.description: All domains found in the Received headers

hops.description: List of hops the message took from Sender to Recipient

in_reply_to.description: In-Reply-To header value which identifies its parent message if exists

ips.description: All IP addresses found in the Received headers

mailer.description: X-Mailer or User-Agent extracted from headers

references.description: The Message-IDs of the other messages within this chain

reply_to.description: Where replies should be delivered to

x_secure_server_account.description: X-SecureServer-Acct header, which represents a unique identifier associated with the sender's email account on a secure server and can be used to trace the email back to a specific account or user.

fields.description: List of all raw header fields contained within this hop

index.description: Index indicates the order in which a hop occurred from sender to recipient

position.description: This field's position along the entire list of header fields

value.description: The value contained within the field

Mdm_serviceIP.description: X-Originating-IP header, which identifies the originating IP address of the sender client

version.description: The version of IP (i.e., 4 or 6), null for backward compatibility.

encoders.description: The radix/form encodings detected on a non-standard IPv4 host that was decoded into 'ip'

original.description: The IP in its original form before any translation occurred

display_text.description: The text of a hyperlink, if it's not a URL

mismatched.description: Whether the display URL and href URL root domains are mismatched (i.e. .href_url.domain.root_domain != .display_url.domain.root_domain, where both are not null and valid domains)

parser.description: The parser that was used to derived the link

visible.description: Whether the link is visible to a human when previewing an email or page

Mdm_serviceMailbox.description: Organizer mailbox with email and display name

Mdm_serviceMailboxExtended.description: The mailbox where the message was found

first_name.description: First name (given name) of the mailbox owner

last_name.description: Last name (surname) of the mailbox owner

Mdm_serviceMessageDataModel.description: Full data model of the message

Mdm_serviceMessageType.description: Override on message types, defined from the perspective of your organization

inbound.description: Message was sent from someone outside your organization, to *at least one* recipient inside your organization

internal.description: Message was sent from someone inside your organization, to *at least one* recipient inside your organization. Messages *must be authenticated* by either SPF or DKIM to be treated as internal.

outbound.description: Message was sent from someone inside your organization, to *at least one* recipient outside your organization

canonical_id.description: A deterministic ID, generated from metadata such as Attachments, Body, Subject, Sender and is used to group similar messages/campaigns together

created_at.description: Creation time of the data model

effective_at.description: Effective time of the data model, used for evaluation against lists and historical functions such as sender profiles or whois.

Mdm_servicePlain.description: The body part containing content-type text/plain

links.description: All links found in the plain part of the body of the message

raw.description: Decoded raw content of a body text type (text/[subtype] section)

banners.description: All warning banners found in the body of the message.

index.description: The index of the thread among all threads, sorted from most recent to oldest

links.description: All links found in the given thread, unique by the target and display text/url.

preamble.description: The preamble text from the thread, typically the headers of a reply or forward. Things like From, Sent, Subject, saved as one big multiline string. This doesn't include banners.

text.description: The text content from the latest reply/forward in a message thread. This typically excludes content from forwarded messages and warning banners.

time.description: Time parsed from the Received header

zone_offset.description: Timezone offset parsed from the Received header

Mdm_serviceReceivedAdditional.description: The remaining additional clauses of the Received header

raw.description: The raw string for remaining additional clauses, such as transport information

Mdm_serviceReceivedBy.description: The 'by' section of the Received header, denoting the current server

Mdm_serviceReceivedFor.description: The 'for' section of the Received header, denoting the destination mailbox

Mdm_serviceReceivedFrom.description: The 'from' section of the Received header, relating to a server in a prior hop

Mdm_serviceReceivedID.description: The 'id' section of the Received header

Mdm_serviceReceivedVia.description: The 'via' section of the Received header, denoting transport

Mdm_serviceReceivedWith.description: The 'with' section of the Received header, denoting the protocol used

Mdm_serviceRewriteDetails.description: Information about an original URL that was unfurled from rewrite detection

encoders.description: List of detected URL rewrite encoders while unraveling the URL

original.description: Original URL without any unraveling URL rewrites

Mdm_serviceSPF.description: Details of the Sender Policy Framework check. Supported fields include 'Received-SPF' and 'X-Received-SPF'

description.description: Verbose description of the SPF verdict

designator.description: Email or domain of the designating body

received_hop.description: The lowest hop at which the SPF check was made

decoders.description: Decoders used to parse the email sender info, if any

name.description: Label name from provider metadata; not necessarily the display name

provider.description: Provider that defined the sensitivity label

provider_account_id.description: External provider account that owns the label, such as a Microsoft Entra tenant ID

Mdm_serviceSignature.description: Details of a message signature. Supported fields include 'DKIM-Signature', 'DomainKey-Signature', 'X-Google-DKIM-Signature' and 'ARC-Message-Signature'

domain.description: Domain identified in the DKIM signature if any. This is the domain that's queried for the public key.

headers.description: Header fields signed by the algorithm

instance.description: Instance number of this signature (if ARC)

type.description: The type of signature, derived from the field name

base.description: Subject of the email with tags and reply/forward indicators removed

is_auto_reply.description: Indicates if the subject of the email is an automatic reply

is_forward.description: Indicates if the subject of the email is a forward

is_reply.description: Indicates if the subject of the email is a reply

tags.description: Leading tags extracted from the subject, e.g. [External] or (Warning)

Mdm_serviceThread.description: The current text thread of the message

banners.description: All warning banners found in the body of the message.

links.description: All links found in the given thread, unique by the target and display text/url.

preamble.description: The preamble text from the thread, typically the headers of a reply or forward. Things like From, Sent, Subject, saved as one big multiline string. This doesn't include banners.

text.description: The text content from the latest reply/forward in a message thread. This typically excludes content from forwarded messages and warning banners.

Mdm_serviceURL.description: URL details when QR code type is url

fragment.description: Fragment identifier; the text following the # in the URL (also called the anchor tag)

password.description: The password specified before the domain name

path.description: Everything after the TLD and before the query parameters

port.description: The port used for the URL. If no explicit port is set, the port will be inferred from the protocol

query_params.description: The full query parameters of the URL

query_params_decoded.description: The decoded query parameters of the URL

scheme.description: Protocol for the URL request, e.g. http

username.description: The username specified before the domain name of the URL

get.description: Retrieve the message's Message Data Model. If there is no justification, it will be redacted.

parameters.description: When true, recompute the MDM from the raw EML. For internal use only!
parameters.name: recompute_mdm_from_raw

schema.description: When true, recompute the MDM from the raw EML. For internal use only!

parameters.description: When true, any text field over 1MB will be cleared before returning
parameters.name: remove_large_text_fields

schema.description: When true, any text field over 1MB will be cleared before returning

get.summary: Retrieve the message's Message Data Model

server.description: Base URL of your Sublime deployment
